thread:
greg_sales: Heads-up 10am POC with Carmen's security team. They want a concise statement on who holds keys, whether HSM keys can be exported, rotation defaults, and a single-line smoke test to run live. Can sec + SRE give a tiny deliverable we can share during the call?
imelda_security: Short pack we can hand in-chat: 1) Custody: Redwood-managed CMKs by default, or BYOK where customer keeps keys in their cloud/HSM; 2) Export: HSM-backed CMKs (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Thales on-prem via Private) are non-exportable by design; 3) Rotation: Redwood-managed default 90d (high-sec) / 365d (standard); BYOK rotation controlled by customer; 4) Audit: redacted KMS event example and pointer to vendor FIPS attestations.
carmen_customer: Quick Q  Does BYOK mean you never see plaintext? Our auditor needs a single-sentence assurance.
imelda_security: Yes single sentence: "For BYOK/imported keys, Redwood never has access to plaintext key material or raw key blobs; we only receive key references/ciphertext."
oliver_sre: Single-line AWS CLI smoke test we can give them to run live (assumes key in their account or demo alias/RedwoodPOC we provisioned):
`aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/RedwoodPOC --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > ct.bin && aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > pt.bin`
oliver_sre: Note: with HSM-backed CMKs the ciphertext never exposes key material; HSM enforces non-export.
dana_pricing: Procurement wants a one-liner for SOW about BYOK/HSM cost impact for POC. Suggested: "BYOK/import support included; on-prem HSM adapters may incur a one-time integration fee and an optional ongoing support add-on; commercial to quote."
greg_sales: Action: @imelda_security to drop the one-paragraph + redacted audit JSON, @oliver_sre to attach the single-line CLI and minimal grant steps, @dana_pricing to include the SOW line. I'll send to Carmen before the 10am POC. Carmen, is that timeline okay?
carmen_customer: Yes that works, please include the FIPS attestation PDFs if available and the audit snippet. We'll run the CLI test if time permits. :thumbsup:
